scope.retained_objective: Negative Reflection of Guided Waves in a Flexoelectric Piezoelectric-Semiconductor Plate with Carrier–Strain-Gradient Coupling
scope.scope: No edge solver, geometry change, manuscript, new material family, or additional coupling
scope.physical_evidence_boundary: Computed finite-carrier classical limit f=A=H=0; nonzero A/H tests synthetic at f=0. Full calibrated flexoelectric model still unavailable.

source.equations: 2–4; Table 1; Appendix A; reference 11 attributes constants to Yang (2020)
source.source_geometry_not_replicated: Simply supported rectangular plate. Its D3=0 condition is not substituted for this checkpoint's exact vacuum exterior.

scenarios_NOT_measured_samples.reason_thickness: Retain original 1 micrometre; add 0.5 micrometre and the source's 3 micrometre example as a bounded micron-scale bracket.
scenarios_NOT_measured_samples.reason_concentration: Retain source-used 1e19; two lower decades test weaker mobile-carrier loss without changing the material or fitting a successful result.
scenarios_NOT_measured_samples.comparison: Same dimensionless longitudinal-thickness family and original target Omega for each d, NOT the same physical frequency.
scenarios_NOT_measured_samples.electrical_exterior: Quasistatic vacuum, potential and normal D continuous; exterior q=K analytic sheet requires Re K>0.
scenarios_NOT_measured_samples.carrier_faces: Blocking particle flux only; no simultaneous N=0 prescription.
scenarios_NOT_measured_samples.unspecified_losses: Only drift–diffusion dissipation is included. Mechanical, surface, defect and contact losses are not calibrated; predicted survival is conditional/optimistic.

numerical_protocol.family: Original branch 5 (one-based), L1 thickness family, U1 even and U3/Phi/N odd
numerical_protocol.complex_K_method: Analytic Fourier bilinear form B(-K)^T, not the old real-K Hermitian form; decaying exterior sheet checked separately.
numerical_protocol.independent_method: Strong-equation eight-state thickness propagator, no Galerkin matrices reused
numerical_protocol.classical_method: Original six-state propagator plus separate K=0 analytic open-circuit thickness cutoff
numerical_protocol.temporal_K_grid: 41 points, 0<=K<=0.08, each of nine design scenarios
numerical_protocol.spatial_real_frequency_grid: 41 points spanning the full frozen classical K→0-to-ZGV frequency interval, two continued roots, each of nine scenarios

synthetic_H_NOT_physical_calibration.normalization: Each direction separately scaled so H:A^-1:H/a=eta^2; strict stability is NOT evidence of physical plausibility.

material_probes.interpretation: Half the last printed increment, as rounding-scale sensitivity probes; NOT measured uncertainties or a probability model.
material_probes.transport_note: Illustrative ±5% common variation of M and D, preserving the tabulated Einstein ratio; not measured uncertainty.
